evaluation: Official KITTI odometry GT only in score.py; full original timestamp support; one SE(3) alignment, no scale; translation and rotation RPE at 1 s; loop relative-transform errors; fixed held-out static revisit geometry.
selection: One archived geometric loop, selected before this semantic experiment. Not a loop detector benchmark or an unseen sequence. Parameters committed before new scoring; no search or GT feedback. All four arms share geometry, downsampling, initialization, optimizer, robust kernel, gate and graph noise. ZS and B0 use frozen pass-1 predictions. G also checked against the original Open3D implementation.
scope: Offline loop measurement refinement, not semantic odometry or online ROS integration. Temporal reliability measures local repeated observation agreement, not object tracking. No GT labels, corrected-map labels, future source frames or current-source observations enter the historical reference. No invented posterior from top-1 cache. Unknown evidence is neutral. Failed candidates fall back to G and are retained in diagnostics. No new training or full map replay.
